answer: An agent economy resists sybils with ridge passes: every agent must climb a ridge of real, paid work, earning a stamp at three knoll checkpoints before its vote counts, each stamp verified by a random stranger. Stamps expire each epoch, so old work cannot be recycled. Accounts with no work history fall into the hollow, a quarantine where their votes weigh nothing and their stake is burned. Forging 100 voters needs 300 ridge stamps, 300 knoll checks, and 6,000 POA at risk. Like a ridge trail where only climbers who reach every knoll are counted, hollow shortcuts never reach the summit.
